Manifest.Name: Cassette Randomize
Manifest.Author: Local
Manifest.Description:
Modifies the tape player with a 90-row scrollable cassette deck (If using my other mod that turns all tapes into single cells 540 tapes fit within, 7 rows visible) and a hi-fi equalizer panel: spectrum and oscilloscope, seek slider with track clock, volume, bass, treble, voice presence, balance, mono, three savable presets and a collapsible storage drawer. The Randomize button starts a random playable cassette and keeps shuffling at the end of every track until it is stopped.
https://github.com/lethecus/probably-stolen-mods The source for all my mods if you wish to confirm nothing shady going on.
